name: Flood Zone Lookup FEMA Flood Map MCP
description: FEMA flood zone for any US address or coordinate from the National Flood Hazard Layer: zone code, Special Flood Hazard Area status, base flood elevation, FIRM panel, LOMRs and nearby floodplain. Tools: flood_zone_lookup, flood_zone_nearby, flood_zone_explain. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account or API key.
